title: Oil-Driven Tightening with Inflation Risk Amid Global Growth Slowdown
description: Coordinated OPEC+ supply cuts, sanctions-driven disruptions, and shipping chokepoints are likely to keep energy prices firm and lift input costs, reinforcing inflation pressures. Simultaneously, manufacturing contractions and worsening supply-chain bottlenecks point to weaker global growth, suggesting a net tilt toward higher prices with subdued activity.

title: Tightening Global Financial Conditions Dampen Growth and Risk Appetite
description: Monetary policy remains hawkish in the United States with sticky inflation and higher yields, lifting the dollar and tightening financial conditions worldwide. This environment is likely to dampen global growth, pressure equity valuations (notably high-growth tech) and sustain a risk-off tone across asset classes.
